Twice it drove straight into the water bowl because the zone was gone. Support told me to factory reset, which I did, which fixed nothing. Battery is fine, it gets through the whole apartment on one charge. Noise is about what you'd expect, the cats hate it but they hate everything. Setup took about fifteen minutes including the account and wifi pairing, which was painless. On the bathroom tile it handled the fringe on the bath mat without choking, which my old one never managed, though the side brush does fling litter around near the box. Hello Seller Performance Team,

Amara Liu
